prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a vertical retro-futurist arcade fashion portrait of a stylish adult woman with a short bixie cut tipped with subtle neon color and clear-rimmed glasses. She wears an opaque charcoal high-neck techwear top, cropped utility jacket, high-waisted cargo skirt over fitted shorts, and unbranded silver jewelry. She leans casually against an unbranded arcade-cabinet joystick, holding a colorful unbranded juice box and looking directly into the lens. Set her in a dim crowded arcade with blurred unbranded cabinets, abstract pink-and-cyan pixel screens, reflective worn floor, and drifting dust in projector beams. Use direct RGB light, pink on one side and teal on the other, a 35mm high-contrast snapshot look, film grain, restrained lens flare, realistic skin texture, and no readable text or logos.
